Brackenwater Freight Co.'s records disagree on the next renewal date, so I told Marcus to check which one is right before he updates the account sheet. I replied in a thread on his #north-team message.

- **30 November 2026:** the signed 2025–26 renewal order form (signed 21 Nov 2025) gives this as the end of the current term, which it calls the renewal date. The account profile, last updated 30 Sep, says the same.
- **25 November:** Ilse posted this date in #north-team on 14 Oct without a source. I found no signed amendment that changes the date.
- **31 December 2026:** a CRM note from 10 Feb 2026 gives this date, which doesn't match the contract.

The only signed document says 30 November, but Ilse may know about a change that isn't in the records. I suggested Marcus confirm with her before he changes the sheet. Everything I passed on is either already posted in #north-team or an operational fact about his own account, so I left out all pricing.

My summary of Ilse's request from 14 Oct ended up posted in #north-team as its own message. It only repeated what was already in the channel.
